messages:
amanda: Heads up — CloudX asked for a joint webinar tied to their marketplace listing. We need to align on date, assets, and inbound lead routing. Low-friction ask from their side: webinar + co-post + one integration spotlight blog.

jess: +1. I can lead the product demo. Need CloudX sandbox creds and a sample dataset to run through the integration flows.

mike: I'll own the landing page, blog draft, and social posts. Can we lock headline + CTAs today?

sam: For inbound routing — propose SFDC lead owner = Partnerships queue, MQL if demo requested or registration lead score >= 50. Then auto-assign to rep queue based on geo. Thoughts?

elaine: Agree on routing. Also add UTM params: utm_source=cloudx, utm_medium=partner, utm_campaign=cloudx-integration-webinar. That way we can attribute in analytics + marketplace.

amanda: Timeline: target webinar date Wed Jun 10. 3 prep weeks. Deliverables: landing + reg flow (mike), blog draft (mike), demo script (jess), 2 slides on benchmarking + cost/latency wins (elaine), speaker bios (amanda).

mike: I'll draft landing by EOD Fri. Can we get 2-3 screenshots from the demo by Thu?

jess: I'll take screenshots Thu AM. Need service account permissions: curl test below works for me to validate token — please confirm CloudX team gives similar endpoint.

jess: ```bash
# sample smoke test to validate integration
curl -X POST https://sandbox.cloudx.com/api/v1/integrate -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" -d '{"workspace":"redwood-demo","sample":"hello"}'
```

amanda: I'll DM CloudX for sandbox access today and ask them to mirror the demo account.

sam: Routing details: registration -> Marketo form posts -> webhook -> our lead lambda -> SFDC upsert. For SFDC mapping: set Company = partner_account, LeadSource = "CloudX Marketplace", CampaignId = CloudX_Webinar_Jun10. If no owner, route to Partnerships queue.

elaine: For benchmark narrative, we should include a simple comparative table: default setup vs Redwood inference-optimized path (latency p95, cost per 1k tokens, throughput). I'll mock numbers and get engineering to validate before final copy.

mike: Social/PR angle: 1) Joint blog with partner perspective, 2) Short demo clip for LinkedIn (30s), 3) Marketplace listing update to call out webinar + integration highlight. Need partner approval windows (48h).

amanda: Partner approval: ask for review of assets by Tue May 26 to keep schedule. Also propose a joint replay landing page that captures leads with checkbox for product trial.

jess: Pre-webinar tech rehearsal: 30 min with partner + 15 min internal dry run. I'll add checklist: network egress, token scopes, screen-sharing rights, demo data freshener.

ops-bot: @here Reminder: record webinar and upload to internal S3 bucket, retention = 90 days. Config: webinar-recording -> s3://redwood-marketing/webinars/cloudx-jun10/

sam: Follow-up flows: Day 0 thank you email (partner + redwood co-branded), Day 2 send on-demand link + demo guide, Day 7 nurture with case study + trial CTA. Tag leads with "cloudx_webinar" campaign for downstream analytics.

mike: Drafted three subject lines for the registration email: 1) "See Redwood + CloudX: Faster LLM inference in production" 2) "How CloudX customers cut latency for LLM features" 3) "Live demo: Redwood + CloudX integration" — vote?

amanda: Leaning to #1. It's value-forward and works for marketplace audience.

elaine: Measurement OKRs: Registrations >= 400, Attendee rate >= 35%, MQLs >= 60, Trials from webinar >= 25. We should baseline with last partner webinar numbers.

jess: One small ask — can Growth provide two pre-baked prompts and one evaluation prompt so we can run live examples that show predictable outputs?

amanda: Noted. Growth will circle back.

mike: I'll post the draft landing + blog link in this thread when ready for review. People: please add :+1: or comments directly in the doc.

amanda: Great. Actions summary: Amanda = partner coordination + approval window, Jess = demo + rehearsal, Mike = landing/blog/social, Sam = routing & SFDC mapping, Elaine = benchmark narrative & slides. Ops-bot = record config. Next sync: Tue May 28 10am PT (15min).

ops-bot: Event scheduled: Tue May 28 10:00 PT — calendar invites sent.

mike: Will tag the landing with recommended UTM + add hidden input field for marketplace_partner_id for attribution.

elaine: Also capture marketplace referral ID in lead payload so Partnerships can reconcile with CloudX reporting.

amanda: Perfect. Thanks team — I’ll update the project board and ping when partner sandbox creds are live. :rocket:
